items.label: WORLD CLASS [N0]
items.why: Nostalgia boot and title path, entered by autostart on side 1 before the course-disk prompt.

items.label: WORLD DOCS  [N0]
items.why: Separate bundled documentation program in the side 1 directory.

items.label: GAME
items.why: Packed main game on side 1. Resident code and the RAM source for the scorecard printer are represented in the engine and printer parts.

items.label: DMO
items.why: Demo hole payload. The traced DMO branch changed the decoded hole block at $C554–$CBFF.

items.label: RNG
items.why: Driving range data. The range selection at $A215 sets $0D7D, which selects RNG at $B97B.

items.label: A00
items.why: Packed numbered-hole streams. The loader at $CC7B computes the stream index from the requested two digits and normally replaces those digits with 00. A01 was traced decoding to the hole block.

items.label: ACT
items.why: Course selection table requested as letter plus CT. BCT was traced populating the title and hole names at $BEE0–$BF45.

items.label: ATF
items.why: Terrain mask bank named by $B99F. The ATF load was traced staging the bank before the $BF50 copy under I/O.
